name: Hurting Other Believers
overview: Scripture teaches that hurting other believers is a serious offense that brings woe upon the offender, as offenses are inevitable but those who cause them bear heavy responsibility (Luke 17:1). Believers are called to respond with love and forgiveness, even toward those who wrong them, reflecting the mercy of God who forgives our trespasses (Matthew 5:44; 6:14). The principle of treating others as we wish to be treated underscores the importance of kindness and respect within the body of Christ (Luke 6:31), while the fear of the Lord provides the foundation for true wisdom and understanding in relationships (Proverbs 1:7). Ultimately, nothing done in secret will remain hidden, emphasizing accountability among believers (Luke 8:17).
